guide.subtitle: Technical Resource
guide.description: Standard sizing charts fail to account for Hawaii’s unique combination of high humidity and persistent heat loads. Installing an oversized unit creates a cold, clammy environment as it short-cycles andfails to dehumidify, while an undersized unit will run continuously, spiking your energy costs without ever reaching comfort. Our proprietary sizing matrix is engineered specifically for Oahu's micro-climates. Use it to determinethe precise BTU capacity required for your space, ensuring maximum efficiency, superior dehumidification, and long-term equipment durability. Don’t guess with your comfort—deploy the correct infrastructure.
guide.info_desc: For rooms with high ceilings (9ft+) or direct afternoon sun, we recommend sizing up by 10% to ensure efficiency.

climate.title: WHY HAWAII'S CLIMATE
climate.description_p1: Oahu's high humidity and constant exposure to saline trade winds create a 'perfect storm' for window and through-the-wall A/C units. Unlike drier climates, Honolulu's air causes rapid condensation buildup within the internal chassis and slinger pan, which often goes unnoticed behind the front louvers.
climate.description_p2_prefix: This moisture, combined with indoor dust, creates a fertile breeding ground for
climate.description_p2_suffix: and bacteria. Without regular professional sanitization, your window AC unit becomes a distribution system for allergens, causing headaches, fatigue, and respiratory irritation.
climate.description_p3_prefix: Furthermore, salt-air corrosion eats away at sensitive aluminum fins and copper tubing. Our deep cleaning process includes a specialized
climate.description_p3_suffix: that neutralizes salt deposits and helps protect your unit from premature coastal corrosion failure.

items.q: How often should I have my window A/C professionally cleaned in Oahu?
items.a: Due to our high humidity and salt-air concentration, we recommend rinsing your slide-out mesh filter every 2-4 weeks and scheduling a deep sanitization every 6-12 months to prevent mold buildup and corrosion.

items.q: Does a dirty window A/C impact electricity bills?
items.a: Yes. Clogged coils force the compressor to work 30-50% harder to achieve the same cooling effect, leading to significantly higher HECO bills and premature motor failure.

items.q: Can I just use a spray bottle from the hardware store?
items.a: Hardware store sprays only treat the front surface. Our window AC deep cleaning process thoroughly cleans and sanitizes the blower wheel, evaporator coil, condenser fins, and drain pan where 90% of mold and salt buildup reside.
